# Code of Conduct

This project follows [Contributor Covenant v2.1][Contributor Covenant].

Report conduct concerns privately through the maintainer contact methods on the maintainer's GitHub profile. Do not open public issues for conduct reports.

Use [GitHub Security Advisories] only for security vulnerabilities.

[Contributor Covenant]: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/
[GitHub Security Advisories]: https://github.com/yowainwright/pk/security/advisories/new
[maintainer's GitHub profile]: https://github.com/yowainwright
